notes.title: 🚨 BREAKING NEWS! "Loving Slaves - Episode 1" HAS OFFICIALLY LANDED! 🚨
notes.content:
The moment you've been waiting for is finally here - Episode 1 is now available to play! That's right, all the drama, choices and consequences you've been curious about are ready for you to experience firsthand. No more teasers, no more countdowns - it's download time!

But wait, there's more! The story doesn't end here. Episode 2 is already confirmed and locked in for a May 2025 release, so consider this just the beginning of an unforgettable journey.
